vision: To be a centre of excellence in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science education, producing graduates who shape intelligent systems and data-driven decisions for industry and society.
mission: To deliver a rigorous, hands-on curriculum that blends mathematical foundations with real-world AI engineering, foster a culture of research and innovation, and prepare ethical, job-ready technologists who lead in the AI era.
hodMessage: Welcome to the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. Our programme is built to take you from your first line of Python to deploying production-grade AI. We focus on building, not just theory — and we are excited to mentor the engineers who will define the next decade of intelligent technology. This message will be updated with the Head of Department's official note.
